paper_title: First Searches for Axions and Axion-Like Particles with the LUX Experiment
notes: Solar axion coupling limit from Fig. 6. Limit of 3.5×10^-12 applies to massless/very light axions (m << 1 keV/c²) where the solar axion flux approximation is valid per Eq. 1 (axio-electric effect). The limit is constant across the sub-keV mass range. Under DFSZ model, this corresponds to axion mass limit of 0.12 eV/c²; under KSVZ model, masses above 36.6 eV/c² are excluded. This is the primary result emphasized in the paper's abstract and conclusion (90% C.L., profile likelihood ratio analysis, 95 live days × 118 kg).
